messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager duty triggered for smart-routing: high error-rate spike in us-east-1 / model-serving (auto-detected at 2026-03-12T09:02Z)
oncall_jess: acked — I'm on it. pulling traces now.
luis: seeing a sudden increase in 502/503s from the gateway logs, clients being bounced between us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Could be routing fallback thrash.
maya: echoing — dashboards show backend model variant mismatch errors: "model-variant-incompatible" in the logs (stack trace snippet below).
maya: ```
ERROR 2026-03-12T09:02:15Z model_gateway: request=tx123 variant=gpt-4x-compat status=502 msg="KV cache missing / incompatible weights"
```
katie: customer-impact report: three enterprise customers reporting 5xx for inference calls (calls to /v1/predict). CS has alerted; one customer (acme-inc) is on a live demo.
dns-team: FYI our global DNS provider shows normal health but some edge locations still resolving to deprecated IPs for the us-east edge VIP (ttl 300). propagation graph shows a small cohort at older RRset.
edge-ops: we saw a config rollout 09:00Z that updated routing rules to prefer variant-tag:stable -> variant-tag:compat as fallback. That rollout included a regex that mistakenly matched 'gpt-4x' -> routed to 'gpt-4x-compat' even when model architecture differs.
oncall_jess: confirmed — the fallback policy picked an incompatible variant for some models which leads to immediate 502s. combined with DNS propagation lag, clients were bounced across regions and hit incompatible backends.
luis: grabbing relevant config diff: ```
- "fallback": [{"match": "^gpt-4x$", "variant": "gpt-4x-compat"}]
+ updated to -> "fallback": [{"match": "gpt-4x.*", "variant": "gpt-4x-compat"}]  # oops greedy match
```
maya: that greedy regex is the cause — matches gpt-4x-large, gpt-4x-legacy, and gpt-4xv2. Some variants are not binary-compatible.
katie: customer-success: sending interim note to affected customers now: brief status + ETA.
dns-team: ALSO — provider shows sporadic edge DNS caches with stale A records for us-east edges (older IPs that route to retired jump boxes). That explains requests gravity to wrong AS paths and increased latency leading to routing fallbacks.
oncall_jess: mitigation plan: 1) rollback routing-policy change (disable new regex fallback) 2) force model-variant-tag pin for live models 3) push edge DNS cache invalidation / lower TTL 4) temporarily rate-limit cross-region fallback to avoid loops.
edge-ops: running rollback now — rolling back routing-policy config to previous commit (sha c3f1b2).
hand off-bot: handing off to luis for next 30m (oncall rotation) — please ack.
luis: ack. I will coordinate edge DNS flush with provider and lock down fallback policy.
dns-team: invoking provider API to purge caches for us-east VIP pool. command: ```
curl -X POST https://api.dnsprov.example.com/v1/zone/us-east/purge -H "Authorization: Bearer $DNS_API" -d '{"targets": ["vip-us-east-1"]}'
```
edge-ops: also issuing intra-edge flush: ```
rake edge:flush[vip-us-east-1]
```
maya: temporarily pinning model routing map to explicit variant IDs to avoid any tag-based regex matches: ```
PATCH /routing/policies/serve-ml
{ "overrides": [{"model":"gpt-4x-large","variant":"g4xl-stable-v12"}]}
```
luis: after rollback and flush: I see 5xx starting to drop in the aggregator. error-rate down from 8% -> 2.1% in last 4 minutes.
katie: CS update sent: "We are seeing reduced errors; mitigation in progress; next update in 30m." :white_check_mark:
customer-success: Acme says demo resumed but reported occasional latency spikes, still watching.
oncall_jess: double-checking smart-routing metrics: circuit-breaker triggers firing less; fallback call rate reduced. but we still have a small cohort of clients resolving deprecated IPs — provider hasn't cleared every edge cache.
dns-team: provider estimated final edge evictions at +12 minutes. we can accelerate by temporarily adding an A record with the new IP and short-circuiting the old IP via upstream BGP announcement, but that requires network ops approval.
edge-ops: network approved a temporary static route via our transit partner for the affected old IP set — prep commands ready.
luis: applying rate limit on cross-region fallback: ```
POST /routing/control/fallback-limit 
{ "region_pair": "us-east1->eu-west1", "max_per_min": 20 }
```
maya: logs show a handful of clients still failing with model-variant-incompatible — tracing specific request ids and returning graceful 429 vs 502 where appropriate to reduce customer impact. will post snippet.
maya: ```
TRACE tx=tx789 src=10.1.3.5 -> edge-vip-old -> eu-west-1 -> backend g4xl-legacy => ModelVariantError: weight-format-mismatch
```
oncall_jess: good — switch to graceful degradation for those paths. Also create an alert to trigger if variant-mismatch > 0.5% after rollback.
katie: customer comms queued for 30m post-incident summary. recommending CS reach out one-off customers who had demos.
hand off-bot: handing back to oncall_jess at 09:35Z — incident still monitored but mitigations applied.
oncall_jess: monitoring. will convene postmortem channel at 14:00Z today. action items: improve rollout regex linting, add preflight to routing-policy PRs, add DNS-propagation watch in canary rollouts, and update runbook to include temporary BGP option.
luis: creating ticket INF-6723 for follow-ups and linking impacted customer tickets.
dns-team: provider confirms final edge purge completed at 09:22Z. all regions now resolving to correct VIP.
oncall_jess: final check — 5xxs back to baseline, fallbacks at nominal rate, customers report recovered. closing paging; will keep thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
